responses.title: Pause Giant AI Experiments: An Open Letter
responses.summary: FLI open letter calling on AI labs to pause for at least six months the training of systems more powerful than GPT-4.

responses.title: Statement on AI Risk
responses.summary: One-sentence statement hosted by CAIS saying that mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority.

responses.title: 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
responses.summary: Third annual index scoring foundation model developers on transparency.

responses.title: Anthropic publishes its Responsible Scaling Policy
responses.summary: Anthropic publishes its Responsible Scaling Policy, a framework tying safety measures to a model's potential for catastrophic risk.

responses.title: Anthropic publishes an updated Responsible Scaling Policy
responses.summary: Anthropic publishes a significant update to its Responsible Scaling Policy.

responses.title: Anthropic releases Responsible Scaling Policy version 3
responses.summary: Anthropic releases the third version of its Responsible Scaling Policy.

responses.title: OpenAI introduces its Preparedness Framework (Beta)
responses.summary: OpenAI introduces a living document describing how it tracks, evaluates and protects against catastrophic risks from powerful models.

responses.title: OpenAI releases an updated Preparedness Framework
responses.summary: OpenAI releases an update to its Preparedness Framework for tracking and preparing for advanced AI capabilities that could introduce risks of severe harm.

responses.title: Google DeepMind introduces the Frontier Safety Framework
responses.summary: Google DeepMind introduces a set of protocols for identifying future AI capabilities that could cause severe harm.

responses.title: Google DeepMind updates the Frontier Safety Framework
responses.summary: Google DeepMind publishes its second iteration of the Frontier Safety Framework, with stronger security protocols.

responses.title: Google DeepMind publishes the third Frontier Safety Framework
responses.summary: Google DeepMind publishes the third iteration of its Frontier Safety Framework.

responses.title: Meta shares its Frontier AI Framework
responses.summary: Meta shares a framework outlining how it considers risk in model-release decisions.

responses.title: Meta publishes version 2 of its framework, renamed Advanced AI Scaling Framework
responses.summary: Meta renames its Frontier AI Framework the Advanced AI Scaling Framework and updates its risk threshold language.

responses.title: xAI publishes its Risk Management Framework
responses.summary: xAI publishes its Risk Management Framework (version dated August 20, 2025) for handling significant risks from developing and releasing models such as Grok.

responses.title: Microsoft publishes its Frontier Governance Framework
responses.summary: Microsoft publishes the initial version of its Frontier Governance Framework, which manages national security and public safety risks from more capable AI models.

responses.title: Microsoft updates its Frontier Governance Framework
responses.summary: Microsoft publishes a one-year update of its Frontier Governance Framework, adding harmful manipulation and loss of control as tracked high-risk capabilities.

responses.title: Google publishes its 2025 Responsible AI Progress Report
responses.summary: Google publishes its Responsible AI Progress Report, describing how it governs, maps, measures and manages AI risks.

responses.title: Google publishes its 2026 Responsible AI Progress Report
responses.summary: Google publishes its 2026 Responsible AI Progress Report.

responses.title: Meta publishes its 2024 Human Rights Report
responses.summary: Meta's annual Human Rights Report for 2024, covering its AI work among other topics. The report file is dated December 2025 by its upload path.

responses.title: Salesforce publishes its first Trusted AI and Agents Impact Report
responses.summary: Salesforce publishes its first Trusted AI Impact Report on its AI principles, policies and review processes.

responses.title: Amazon Web Services responsible AI page
responses.summary: Amazon Web Services describes its responsible AI approach, dimensions and tools on its website.

responses.title: Apple describes its Responsible AI principles for Apple Intelligence
responses.summary: Apple states Responsible AI principles to guide how it develops AI tools and the models behind them.

responses.title: White House voluntary AI commitments from seven companies
responses.summary: Seven AI companies committed at the White House to voluntary measures on safety, security and trust, as listed in the White House fact sheet.

responses.title: White House voluntary AI commitments from eight additional companies
responses.summary: Eight further AI companies made the same voluntary commitments, as listed in the White House fact sheet.

responses.title: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
responses.summary: Position paper by individual authors from AI labs and research organizations recommending research into, and tracking of, chain-of-thought monitorability.; the organizations themselves are not recorded as signatories and no ties are drawn from the affiliations. Its authors sign as individuals; their listed affiliations are not organizational authorship.

responses.title: A Right to Warn about Advanced AI
responses.summary: Open letter from current and former employees of frontier AI companies on whistleblower protections and open criticism. Signers are individuals; none of the named signers has a person record on this site, so no ties are drawn.
